name: npc-market-statistics
description: Candidate 0.1.16 native HUD, receipts, archive and statistics visual checks. Run only in the isolated populated fixture world; never in the live play tree.

setup.clientEval:
import __builtin__, blue, time
assert session.charid == 140000006
assert getattr(sm.GetService('viewState').GetCurrentView(),'name',None) == 'hangar'
assert not uicore.layer.loading.display, 'Wait for the station loading screen before visual checks'
assert not any(x.name == 'loadingindicator' and x.display for x in uicore.desktop.children), 'Wait for the client loading indicator before visual checks'
o = __builtin__._evejs_npc_market_buyers_v1
assert o.usable()
o.open_window()
w = o.windowClass.GetIfOpen()
assert w is not None
w.SetSize(1600,1100)
w.left,w.top = 200,70
w.SelectPage('orders')
blue.pyos.synchro.SleepWallclock(2200)
assert not w._busy
assert w._orderSummary == {'activeCount':10,'soldISK':266136500,'remainingISK':714462500,'totalISK':980599000}
assert len(w._orderData) == 10
w.SetViewMode('orders','icons')
blue.pyos.synchro.SleepWallclock(1200)
{'check':'normal mod window opens; active-order totals match actual native receipts','summary':w._orderSummary}
setup.note: Open the normal native mod window, not a mockup; validate ten real sell orders.
Orders remain complete in details view, with readable ISK captions.
Orders remain complete in list view, with readable ISK captions.

setup.clientEval:
started=time.time()
samples=[]
for days in (None,17,36500):
    t=time.time()
    response=o.request('NpcMarketStatistics',__import__('json').dumps({'days':days}))
    assert response.get('success',True)
    data=response['statistics']
    assert len(data['buckets'])<=61
    if days is None:
        assert data['totals']=={'purchases':12010,'units':52727269,'grossISK':56897756880,'taxISK':4551820548,'netISK':52345936332,'unknownTax':0}
    samples.append({'days':days,'milliseconds':round((time.time()-t)*1000,1),'purchases':data['totals']['purchases']})
w.SelectPage('statistics')
blue.pyos.synchro.SleepWallclock(1800)
assert not w._busy
{'check':'all-history and custom-range accounting; bounded graphs','rpcSamples':samples}
setup.note: Read persisted 12,010-sale totals through the real client RPC path; measure three ranges.

setup.clientEval: w.SelectStatisticsPeriod(None,'','custom'); w._statisticsDayEdit.SetValue(17); w.ApplyStatisticsDays(); blue.pyos.synchro.SleepWallclock(1800); assert w._statisticsDays==17; assert not w._dirty; assert w._statisticsDayEdit.GetValue()==17
setup.note: Apply an arbitrary 17-day range without marking configuration dirty.

setup.clientEval: w.SelectPage('activity'); blue.pyos.synchro.SleepWallclock(1800); assert len(w._activityData)==100; assert w._activityMeta['recentCount']==500; assert w._activityMeta['archiveCount']==11510; w.SetViewMode('activity','list'); blue.pyos.synchro.SleepWallclock(1200)
setup.note: Recent Activity stays bounded and keeps icons in List view.

Archived payment amounts and readable captions remain visible in details view.
